description: Implementation of SSDP device recovery functions, including device IP address recovery based on MAC address, using SSDP discovery and linked list management.

classes.name: _recoverSearch
classes.description: Object container for each device recovery request, holding mutex, condition, handle, MAC address, and IP address.

methods.name: findByMacAddress
methods.description: Search function to find a recoverSearch object in the linked list by matching MAC address bytes.

methods.name: ipRecoveryCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon SSDP device discovery, matches device MAC to ongoing searches and updates IP address if matched.

methods.name: destroyRecovery
methods.description: Cleanup function to free resources associated with a recoverSearch object.

methods.name: findSearchObject
methods.description: Pointer comparison function for linked list search.

methods.name: deleteSearchObject
methods.description: Deletes a recoverSearch object from the linked list, freeing resources.

methods.name: cleanupList
methods.description: Removes a recoverSearch object from the linked list and destroys it if list becomes empty.

methods.name: ssdpRecoverIpAddress
methods.description: Main function to recover device IP address via SSDP based on MAC address, with timeout handling.
